name: Angelica's Temptation
source:
Angelica is passing through a very difficult phase in her marriage - her husband Henry is having problems with his work and it also affects their sex life. Angelica's temptation begins on the day Henry's best friend Mark comes to live with them. He is going through a nasty divorce, thus needing a place to lay low for a while, while the divorce is settled.

The story also introduces Aria, who is Angelica's best friend. They have always been like sisters, but Aria has started to develop feelings toward Angelica - she wants them be more than friends and hopes Angelica feels the same...

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/Saruh]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
安吉莉卡正在经历婚姻中非常困难的阶段 - 她的丈夫亨利的工作出现问题，这也影响了他们的性生活。当亨利最好的朋友马克搬来和他们住在一起的那天，安吉莉卡的诱惑就开始了。他正在经历一场令人不快的离婚，因此需要一个地方暂时低调，以便离婚协议得到解决。

故事还介绍了安吉丽卡最好的朋友阿丽亚。他们一直像姐妹一样，但艾莉亚开始对安吉莉卡产生感情——她希望他们不仅仅是朋友，也希望安吉莉卡也有同样的感觉……
